definitions.explanation: A sweeping, fundamental change to a system, institution, or way of doing things. Stronger than mere improvement — implies restructuring or overhaul at a deep level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{変革|へんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。

⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{変革|へんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらした→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧。
examples.english: Technological progress brought about great transformation in industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変革|へんかく}なくして、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}しない→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Without reform of the education system, this problem will likely not be solved.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used in political, social, and business contexts. Often appears in discussions of systemic or institutional change. Carries a more dramatic, fundamental connotation than ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧ (reform), though the two overlap significantly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{変革|へんかく}: social reform/revolution
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧{変革|へんかく}: change in mindset
- {変革|へんかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: bring about change
- {変革|へんかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: era of transformation
- ⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧{変革|へんかく}: structural transformation

SIMILAR WORDS:
{変革|へんかく} implies a fundamental, sweeping transformation. ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧ (reform) is the most common word for institutional reform and may be more incremental. ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧ (revolution) implies even more drastic, often violent change.
